```{r setup}
library(FACD)
```

## Data preprocessing

Before calling `FACD()`, scale all observed times and `time_grid` to `[0, 1]`
using one mapping across subjects and features within each dataset. Use the same
units and reference interval when X and Y share a physical time axis.
Feature-wise z-score standardization across subjects and time points is
recommended; remove features with no finite observations or zero variance first.
Keep subjects in the same order in both datasets.

`wrap_dat()` automatically rescales time, but its value scaling uses the RMS of
the uncentered values rather than the standard deviation. Apply `scale()` to raw
feature columns before wrapping if z-score preprocessing is desired. `FACD()`
itself does not perform these scaling steps. The bundled datasets are already
prepared. See `?FACD` for the worked example and `?wrap_dat` for preprocessing details.
